kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.gf_detail: Ask. Shichimi and sansho blends are spices (shop site); the pork buns sold at the shop are wheat (2024–26 reviews). No allergen information.
kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.vegan_detail: Ask. The spice blends are plant-based by nature but no vegan claim is sourced; the dashi packs and the chicken-oil condiment are not vegan (shop site), and the buns contain pork.
kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.hours_raw: Takeaway only — a spice shop, no seating (Tabelog). 9:30–17:30, varying with the season; open all year (Tabelog). Tastings before you buy (2017–21 reviews). Pork buns with the house shichimi, ¥500, sold from the shop (May 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Online shop and stockists (shop site). Founded in the Meireki era (shichimiya.co.jp); the recipe is described as passed down to a single heir (「一子相伝の味」). At the meeting of Sannenzaka and Gojozaka on the way to Kiyomizu-dera (shop site).
kyoto_shichimiya_honpo.notes: [Shichimi · takeaway · Kiyomizu] A spice shop at the fork of Sannenzaka and Gojozaka that has sold its own shichimi togarashi since the Meireki era — "over three hundred years", the shop says: blends heavy on sansho, chilli powders, dashi packs, and a shichimi pork bun to eat as you walk. Takeaway only. Founded in the Meireki era (shichimiya.co.jp); recipe passed to a single heir, per the shop site.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site: 「明暦年間の創業以来」 — founded in the Meireki era, "over three hundred years" (三百有余年), the recipe kept as 「一子相伝の味」, passed down to a single heir.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: preserving a flavour passed to a single heir.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 buyer grew up with this shop’s shichimi — the one always kept at home by the reviewer’s mother — and loves it on udon.
A May 2026 visitor ate the ¥500 pork bun with a shake of the house shichimi after visiting Kiyomizu-dera.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 明暦年間の創業以来、三百有余年、一子相伝の味、産寧坂・五条坂の交わる場所、七味・一味・山椒、だしパック、鶏油の調味料、カルビーと作ったポテトのお菓子、オンラインショップ。食べログ: その他、東山区清水2-221、9:30〜17:30 (季節により変更)、年中無休、持ち帰りのみ、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年9月・2026年5月、英語): 山椒の香りの七味、うどんに、350年以上の老舗、七味をかけて食べる肉まん500円。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; ask to taste blends before buying.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated September 2025 and May 2026.

kyoto_teppachi_chicken.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: karaage, croquettes, fried rice, soy-seasoned stir-fries (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppachi_chicken.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken izakaya — karaage, chicken stir-fries, katsuo tataki (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppachi_chicken.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Wed, Fri, Sat 18:00–22:00; holidays and the day before 18:00–22:30; closed Thursday and Sunday; lunch from 11:30 until sold out (Tabelog). Lunch is one daily set, ¥800–850 with a free large rice, plus bento to take away from ¥500 (November 2025, January 2026); it fills quickly (November 2026). Dinner courses with all-you-can-drink, ¥4,500 (January 2026). Reservations until the day before (Tabelog). Dogs welcome inside, including the three private rooms upstairs (January 2024, January and November 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay (Tabelog). 25 seats: a five-seat counter downstairs, private rooms upstairs (Tabelog; 2024 review). Down a narrow alley just east of Kawaramachi-Marutamachi (2024 review, November 2025).
kyoto_teppachi_chicken.notes: [Karaage izakaya · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi] A small alley izakaya near Kawaramachi-Marutamachi known for juicy karaage: an ¥800-odd daily lunch set with free large rice and cheap bento, and ¥4,500 all-you-can-drink courses at night. Dogs are welcome inside, even in the private rooms upstairs. Closed Thursday and Sunday; PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an izakaya opened 9 January 2023 near Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, serving chicken dishes, lunch sets and bento.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 family chose it for a daughter’s twentieth-birthday dinner because the dog could come inside, and had the ¥4,500 course in a private room upstairs.
A November 2025 lunch diner had the ¥800 set of karaage and stir-fried chicken with eggplant, with a free large rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・鶏料理、中京区末丸町278-6、夜は月火水金土18:00〜22:00、祝日と祝日の前日18:00〜22:30、木・日曜休み、昼は11:30から売り切れまで、予約は前日まで、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、25席、2023年1月9日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年11月、英語): 唐揚げが名物、昼は日替わり定食800〜850円 (ご飯大盛り無料)、弁当500円から、夜は飲み放題付きのコース4,500円、韓国風のおにぎり、犬も店内可、2階に完全個室3室、河原町丸太町の東の路地。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by the day before for dinner; bring your dog if you like. Cash or PayPay only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.gf_detail: Ask. The matcha tiramisu is described as gluten-free (March 2026); the baked cheesecake and seasonal sweets are not. No cross-contact information.
kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the matcha tiramisu is described as vegan (March 2026); ask about plant milk for lattes. The baked cheesecake is not vegan.
kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.hours_raw: Daily except Tuesday 7:30–18:00 (Tabelog). 「各自ワンドリンクオーダー必須キャッシュレスオンリー（現金払い不可）」 — one drink per person, and cashless only, no cash (Tabelog). A counter and benches beside a small gallery with changing exhibitions (March and April 2026). Closed 8–30 June 2026 for renovation (May 2026). In a renovated wooden townhouse that was a tobacco shop, near Higashi Honganji and Shoseien, about ten minutes from Kyoto Station; opened 2 February 2026 (Tabelog; February and April 2026).
kyoto_geijutsu_kissa_itoyufu.notes: [Gallery café · near Higashi Honganji] A quiet gallery café opened in 2026 by the Kyoto pottery brand QUTOTEN. in an old tobacco shop near Higashi Honganji: matcha lattes and coffee in its own tea ware, a vegan, gluten-free matcha tiramisu, baked cheesecake and seasonal sweets, with art and bonsai on show. Cashless only; one drink each; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a gallery café produced by the Kyoto pottery brand QUTOTEN., opened 2 February 2026 in a renovated wooden former tobacco shop; the name refers to spider threads shimmering in the air (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha latte in house tea ware; matcha tiramisu.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor watched the unsweetened matcha latte made to order and noted the small matcha tiramisu is vegan and gluten-free.
A March 2026 guest came for an exhibition of bonsai-like works and had a matcha latte in a QUTOTEN. collaboration cup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、下京区天神町396-4、火曜以外7:30〜18:00、各自ワンドリンクオーダー必須、キャッシュレスのみ (現金不可)、2026年2月2日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): 京都の陶磁器ブランド QUTOTEN. のギャラリーカフェ、元たばこ屋の木造の町家を改装、ギャラリーの展示が変わる、抹茶ティラミス800円 (ヴィーガン・グルテンフリー)、ベイクドチーズケーキ850円、季節の甘味1,000円、季節のドリンク1,000円、カフェラテ700円、無糖の抹茶ラテ、Komyo tea 500円、ブレンド、タンザニアの浅煎り、カウンターとベンチ、東本願寺・渉成園の近く、京都駅から徒歩約10分、2026年6月8日〜30日は改装で休み。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring a card or app — no cash. One drink each. Seats are a counter and benches, so it can be close. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_kihara_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled beef and offal with sauces, chijimi, cold noodles; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_kihara_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_kihara_nijo.hours_raw: Dinner daily 17:00–23:00 (last orders 22:00); lunch Tuesday–Friday 11:30–14:00 (last orders 13:30); open all year (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog, original チャージ料なし). Cards (Tabelog). 52 seats: 20 at tables, 32 on tatami (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Courses from ¥3,850 (Tabelog). Bookings for one accepted (September 2026). Near Karasuma-Marutamachi (September 2026).
kyoto_yakiniku_kihara_nijo.notes: [Yakiniku · north of Nijo, charcoal and tatami] A long-running, affordable charcoal yakiniku near Karasuma-Marutamachi with tatami rooms for groups: busy office-worker lunch sets of outside skirt, fresh offal and misuji at night, half-size cold noodles, courses from ¥3,850. Smoking allowed. Open every day.

chef_bio.chef_name: 木原大輔 (given name reading not sourced)
chef_bio.background: The receipt invoice number on Tabelog belongs to 木原大輔, an individual (NTA register). No other details were found.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 solo diner, glad a booking for one was accepted, found oolong tea refills free after the second cup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: きはら、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、中京区両替町二条上ル北小路112、夜 毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、昼 火〜金 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、年中無休、チャージ料なし、カード可、52席 (テーブル20、座敷32)、喫煙可、コースは3,850円から。適格請求書: 木原大輔 (個人)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 手頃でにぎやかな炭火焼肉、ハラミのジュージューランチ、新鮮なセンマイ、チヂミ、ミスジ、冷麺のハーフ、キムチ・ナムル・サラダ・焼き野菜・豚バラ・冷麺のコース、2杯目以降のウーロン茶は無料、1人でも予約可。

cultural_comfort.note: Local yakiniku; tatami rooms; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated January 2025 to September 2026.

kyoto_challe_gosho.gf_detail: Ask. French crullers and donuts are made with rice flour, but wheat-free status, shared fryers and the churros and taco shells are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_challe_gosho.vegan_detail: Ask. Nothing is described as vegan; the morning plate has egg and bacon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_challe_gosho.hours_raw: 9:00–17:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). Seating upstairs; stump-style stools (April and July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Near the Kyoto Imperial Palace park, just off the main street (April and September 2026). Opened 12 July 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_challe_gosho.notes: [Café · by the Imperial Palace park, crullers and tacos] A small café near the Imperial Palace park from the team behind loose kyoto and HOO: rice-flour French crullers, crisp churros with chocolate sauce, little tacos made to order and a morning plate from 9:00, with good coffee and freshly whisked matcha lattes. Open daily. Flagged: sister of loose kyoto and HOO (both in our data).

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe CHALLE as the newest sister café of the Kyoto donut cafés loose kyoto and HOO (April and July 2026). Opened July 2024 (Tabelog). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor fuelled up with the Good Morning Plate before a stroll through the Imperial Palace park.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: CHALLE、カフェ、上京区信富町315-1、毎日 9:00〜17:00、2024年7月12日オープン、カード・電子マネー可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): loose kyoto と HOO の姉妹店、米粉のフレンチクルーラー400円、点てた抹茶の抹茶ラテ700円、チュロスとチョコソース650円 (ホイップ+100円)、目玉焼き・ベーコン・アボカドのグッドモーニングプレート、注文後に作るタコス、チュロスとバナナのセット、2階に席、切り株のような椅子、京都御苑の近く。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual café; open daily from 9:00.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated April to October 2026.

kyoto_8blackbirds_cafe_shichijo.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee with croque monsieur, cookies and cheesecake; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_8blackbirds_cafe_shichijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is plant-only; the food uses cheese, bacon and white sauce (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_8blackbirds_cafe_shichijo.hours_raw: 7:30–17:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Counter seats with power outlets (July 2026). Coffee beans to take away (July 2026). At Kawaramachi-Shichijo (December 2025; July 2026). Opened 1 September 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_8blackbirds_cafe_shichijo.notes: [Coffee roaster café · Kawaramachi-Shichijo, from 7:30] A calm, stylish roaster café with a bird logo between Kyoto Station and Shichijo: single-origin coffee of the day, a crisp croque monsieur for breakfast, cookies and cheesecake, counter seats with power outlets, and beans to take home. Open daily from 7:30.

chef_bio.background: No operator or roaster details were found. Opened September 2023 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular who usually only bought beans here stayed for a Kenyan iced coffee and a cookie at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 8Black birds Cafe、カフェ、下京区材木町466-4、毎日 7:30〜17:00、2023年9月1日オープン、カード可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 自家焙煎のコーヒー、本日のコーヒー (エチオピア、ケニア) 600円、深煎りのマンデリン、ベーコン・ホワイトソース・チーズ・バジルのクロックムッシュ650円、チーズケーキ650円、クッキー300円、カウンター席にコンセント、豆の販売、河原町七条。

cultural_comfort.note: Work-friendly counter with outlets.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated February 2025 to July 2026.

kyoto_osoba_kyoshimi_nijojo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba (wheat content not stated), tempura and curry soba (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osoba_kyoshimi_nijojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba in dashi; shrimp tempura and oyakodon (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osoba_kyoshimi_nijojo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00; closed Friday (Tabelog). No service or cover charge (Tabelog, original サービス料・チャージともなし). Cards: AMEX (Tabelog). 22 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at sunken-kotatsu tables, 2 at a table (Tabelog). English menu (March 2026). On Oike-dori toward Nijo Castle (March 2026).
kyoto_osoba_kyoshimi_nijojo.notes: [Soba · Oike near Nijo Castle, lunch only] A dignified old neighbourhood soba shop behind a green noren on the way to Nijo Castle: freshly fried tempura soba, zaru soba, curry soba and rice-bowl sets in a rich dashi, with an English menu. Lunch only; closed Friday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-established neighbourhood soba shop (May 2025; October 2026). No operator or founding date was found.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner walking from Karasuma-Oike toward Nijo Castle found the counter shared with overseas visitors reading the English menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 御蕎麦 京吉美、そば、中京区小川通御池上る下古城町398 ロイヤルプラザ御池1F、昼 11:30〜14:00、金曜定休、サービス料・チャージなし、カードはAMEX、22席 (カウンター8、掘りごたつ12、テーブル2)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昔ながらの近所のそば屋、海老2本の天ぷらそば、ざるそば、カレーそば、親子丼と温かいそばのセット、とろろご飯のセット+300円、英語メニュー、二条城への御池通沿い、緑の暖簾。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; many overseas visitors.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated May 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_royal_kitchen_bar.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: lunch sets come with naan (plain or cheese), and the curries are not described (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_royal_kitchen_bar.vegan_detail: Ask. Reviews mention keema, chicken tikka and mutton curries; no vegetable curry or vegan option is described.
kyoto_royal_kitchen_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:15). Lunch sets A–D around ¥1,080–1,180 with naan, curry, chicken tikka and a soft drink; extra naan ¥100 (2026). Reservations taken. No service charge (「なし」, Tabelog Japanese original). 36 seats: 8 at the counter, 28 at tables; a stage and a bar counter. Non-smoking (smoking area outside). Cards and QR codes; no e-money. On Horikawa-dori at Ayanokoji, 7 min from Hankyu Omiya.
kyoto_royal_kitchen_bar.notes: [Curry · Horikawa-Ayanokoji, a curry house with a stage] A lively Nepali-Indian curry restaurant and bar with a stage and chandelier, popular with Indian diners: lunch sets with naan, curry and chicken tikka from about ¥1,080, open all day to 10:30 pm. Medium spice is properly spicy.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2026) describe a former-venue interior with a stage, chandelier and bar counter, many Indian customers and, one evening, dancing (February 2026). Only four reviews so far; one June 2026 diner found the cheese naan small. Whether it belongs to a group is not stated.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "There were many Indian customers, which shows its popularity. The atmosphere was lively and fun, with girls even dancing!"
June 2026: "I ordered the B Lunch Set for JPY 1080, tax included, with an extra naan for JPY 100… It comes with chicken tikka and a soft drink."
June 2026: "Even the medium spicy option had quite a kick!… The cheese naan was a bit small and the cheese was also a bit lacking."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: THE ROYAL KITCHEN & BAR、アジア・エスニック・居酒屋・インドカレー、下京区綾堀川町304-2 乳業会館1F、阪急大宮から徒歩7分、毎日11:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:15)、予約可、チャージ「なし」、36席 (カウンター8・テーブル28)、禁煙 (屋外に喫煙所)、カード・QR可。口コミ (2026年2〜9月、英語、4件): ネパール・インドのカレー店、ステージとシャンデリア、インドの客が多い、ロイヤルセット1,180円 (マトン+100円)、Bランチ1,080円 (キーマ、ナン、チキンティッカ、ソフトドリンク)、Aランチ、チーズナンのセット、Dランチ、ナン追加100円、中辛でもしっかり辛い、チーズナンが小さいとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: International crowd; lunch sets; open all day.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated February to September 2026.

kyoto_somewhere_bar.gf_detail: Ask. A drinks-led bar; the snacks reviewed — fruit salad with nam pla, tomato with kombu and pecorino, eggplant with eggplant dressing — are not described for gluten (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_somewhere_bar.vegan_detail: Ask. Snacks include an eggplant dish and a fruit salad, but one uses nam pla (fish sauce) and another pecorino (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_somewhere_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Wed, Sat, Sun 16:00–24:00; Fri 19:00–24:00; closed Thursday and irregular days; on the day after a public holiday it opens at 19:00. No cards or QR codes. On the 2nd floor of the Okazaki building on Teramachi-dori just south of Marutamachi, with a big window onto Marutamachi; 447 m from Jingu-Marutamachi.
kyoto_somewhere_bar.notes: [Music bar · Teramachi-Marutamachi, gin and good records from 4 pm] A relaxed upstairs bar with a window on Marutamachi: house gins and tonics, clever little snacks, and a carefully chosen soundtrack through five Bose speakers. About ¥2,000–4,000. No cards. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: An October 2025 reviewer praises the owner's selection of Japanese and international chill songs, the sound from five Bose speakers and the focus on distilled spirits. Only three reviews so far.

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "The carefully arranged five Bose speakers play a selection of exquisite chill songs, both Japanese and international, curated by the owner."
July 2026: "I was truly impressed by the eggplant with eggplant dressing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: SOMEWHERE、バー、中京区寺町通丸太町下御霊町631 岡崎ビル2F、神宮丸太町から447m、月・火・水・土・日16:00〜24:00、金19:00〜24:00、木曜休み、不定休、祝日の翌日は19時から、カード・QR不可。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年7月、英語、3件): 蒸留酒が中心の音楽のバー、店主の選曲と5台のBoseのスピーカー、丸太町通を望む大きな窓、カルダモンのオリジナルのジントニック、サウナジンのソーダ、ナンプラーの季節のフルーツのサラダ、トマトと昆布と山椒とペコリーノ、なすのなすドレッシング。

cultural_comfort.note: Small bar; good for solo visits; no cards.

kyoto_an_marutamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the menu centres on homemade-bread French toast and toast plates (2026 reviews).
kyoto_an_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: French toast with egg custard, bacon, cheese, mascarpone and ice cream; milk teas and lattes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_an_marutamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 8:00–22:00; closing days vary. Reservations taken. Cards, IC cards and QR codes. Non-smoking. Sofas, tables and a counter in a Taisho-romantic machiya filled with art and antiques. Opened in spring 2026 (April 2026 review: 1 April). On Marutamachi-dori east of Tominokoji, south of the Imperial Palace, 530 m from Marutamachi Station.
kyoto_an_marutamachi.notes: [Café · Marutamachi-Tominokoji, French toast in a Taisho-style machiya] A new, antique-filled machiya café open 8 am–10 pm: thick homemade-bread French toast with savoury or fruit toppings, hand-drip coffee and seasonal kakigori. Plates about ¥1,400–2,000. Generous — come hungry.

chef_bio.background: Opened in spring 2026 (reviews give 1 April, one says March) in a renovated machiya decorated with art and antiques in a Taisho-romantic style, with sofas and an Italian-style table (2026 reviews). One September 2026 diner found the custard not fully soaked through and the portion tiring.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "The French toast, made with homemade bread, is incredibly thick yet surprisingly fluffy. The savory aroma of grilled corn combined with the richness of butter and a hint of salt created a delightful sweet and savory flavor."
May 2026: "This elegant Kyoto townhouse café, located south of the Imperial Palace, is adorned with art and antiques, exuding a sense of Taisho Roman."
September 2026: "The French toast was quite thick, and in some parts, the custard mixture hadn't fully soaked through… I found myself getting a bit tired of it halfway through."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: an.、カフェ、中京区丸太町富小路東入338、丸太町から530m、毎日8:00〜22:00、定休日は変動、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 2026年春に開店の大正ロマン風の町家カフェ、アートと骨董、自家製パンの厚いフレンチトースト、フレンチトーストのプレート1,400円 (サラダとヨーグルト、目玉焼きやアボカドチーズ+200円、焼きとうもろこしバター+300円、キャラメルバナナ、いちじく)、トーストのプレート1,200円、キャラメルシナモンとティラミスチョコのフレンチトースト1,300円、桃のかき氷、ハンドドリップのコーヒー、ココナッツコーヒー750円、桜ソーダ750円、生地の染み込みが足りない・量が多いとの声 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Calm café from 8 am; large portions.

kyoto_yamadaruma_nanajo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: marinated meats, soy- and miso-based sauces, wasabi soy sauce and cold noodles (2022–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_yamadaruma_nanajo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku of beef, pork, chicken and offal (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yamadaruma_nanajo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken. SMOKING ALLOWED (Tabelog); reviewers say the ventilation is poor and clothes and hair smell of smoke (October 2024, May 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR codes. 31 seats: 7 at the 1st-floor counter, 24 on tatami upstairs (steep stairs). By Shichijo Ohashi bridge, 3 min from Keihan Shichijo.
kyoto_yamadaruma_nanajo.notes: [Yakiniku · Shichijo Ohashi, a sake-friendly grill bar] A friendly two-floor yakiniku near Keihan Shichijo: premium beef and loin with wasabi soy, salted tongue, sansho chicken neck and stone-pot bibimbap, with good sake. About ¥4,000–6,000. Smoky — dress for it. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A sister of the izakaya やまだるま on Rokkaku (kyoto_yamadaruma_rokkaku in this guide), whose record notes this shop. Reviewers find the meat good for the price and the service good (2023–2025); the recurring complaint is smoke from poor ventilation (2024, 2026).

anecdotes.text: April 2025: "You can enjoy the meat either with sauce or in a refreshing style with wasabi and soy sauce… our total bill was under JPY 12,000 for two people."
September 2025: "I enjoyed solo yakiniku at the counter on the first floor. The incredibly tender premium beef melted in my mouth."
October 2024: "The quality and service were good, but the ventilation was so poor that everything, including my clothes and hair, ended up smelling like yakiniku."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都七条焼肉酒場 やまだるま、焼肉・ホルモン、下京区七条通加茂川筋西入稲荷町459、京阪七条から徒歩3分、月・火・木〜日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、水曜休み、予約可、31席 (1階カウンター7・2階座敷24)、喫煙可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2022年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 七条大橋近くの焼肉酒場、タレ・塩・わさびじょうゆ、上質な牛、ロース、カルビ (塩・味噌)、ねぎ塩タン、せせりの山椒焼き、レバー、石焼ビビンバ、冷麺、きゅうりキムチ、梅の豆腐サラダ、レモンと辛いタレ、デザート、2人で12,000円未満 (2025年4月)、換気が悪く煙のにおいがつくとの声 (2024年10月、2026年5月)、2階の階段が急。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter for solo diners; smoky; steep stairs to the tatami floor.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to October 2026.

kyoto_kashiwaya_mitsusada.gf_detail: Ask. Wagashi such as agar-based suri-kohaku, soy-flour rakugan with bean paste, and rice cake with white miso; full ingredients are not published (Waraku; reviews).
kyoto_kashiwaya_mitsusada.vegan_detail: Ask. The sweets described are built on agar, sugar, soy flour, bean paste, rice cake and white miso, but full ingredients are not published (Waraku; reviews).
kyoto_kashiwaya_mitsusada.hours_raw: TAKEAWAY ONLY — a wagashi shop with no seating listed (Tabelog). 10:00–18:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog; hours also mapple). Cash only (Tabelog). Gyoja-mochi is sold only once a year, on 16 July during the Gion Festival — about 8,000 pieces; a July 2025 reviewer reports in-person sales only since 2016 (mapple still mentions booking by 16 July — check), with a queue of 80-plus from early morning and an early opening (July 2025 reviews). Higashiyama-Yasui, by the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop (co-trip).
kyoto_kashiwaya_mitsusada.notes: [Wagashi · Higashiyama-Yasui, takeaway only] A family wagashi house since 1806 whose 行者餅 — rice cake with white miso and sansho — is sold just once a year on 16 July for the Gion Festival, drawing a dawn queue. All year: おゝきに agar sweets from the 11th-generation head, and 音羽山. Cash only; closed Sunday.

roles: Head of the house, 11th generation (co-trip; Waraku)
chef_bio.background: A Kyoto wagashi house founded in 1806 (Waraku). Waraku describes the 10th generation as still a working confectioner in the mid-80s at the time of writing, and describes おゝきに as a family effort: the 11th-generation head reworked the 9th generation’s summer agar sweet for tea ceremonies, 京氷室 (Kyo-himuro), and the 10th set the concept. co-trip also credits おゝきに to the 11th generation. A July 2025 reviewer retells the 1806 origin of 行者餅, made during an epidemic and offered to En-no-Gyoja, and about 8,000 sold on its one day a year.
chef_bio.philosophy: “The method is a secret (laughs). The hint is air-in chocolate.” — the 10th generation on おゝきに (Waraku).
chef_bio.specialty: 行者餅 (once a year); おゝきに.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 visitor took two days off to queue from 8:40 am for the once-a-year gyoja-mochi.
A July 2026 first-timer found the sansho, then the white miso, inside the rice cake a surprise.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 和楽web (2021年『和樂』の転載、2023年9月時点のデータ): 柏屋光貞「おゝきに」、文化3 (1806) 年創業、10代目の中川タ津也 (たつや) さんは80代半ばの今も現役の職人、9代目が考案した寒天菓子「京氷室」をもっと気楽にと11代目が製法を開発し、10代目がコンセプトを固めた、すり琥珀、白はプレーン・ピンクは梅・緑が柚子・茶が黒糖、1箱1,435円 (税込)、50個入り、通年、「音羽山」は中煎りの大豆粉の落雁で中にこしあん、京都市東山区安井毘沙門町33-2。co-trip: 11代目が考案した「おゝきに」は黒糖、プレーン、梅、柚子の4種類、市バス東山安井下車すぐ。mapple: 10:00〜18:00、通年、おゝきに1,200円、行者餅 (3個入り) 1,200円、音羽山1個70円、行者餅は7月16日までに予約。食べログ: 和菓子、月〜土 10:00〜18:00、日曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 行者餅は祇園祭の7月16日だけ、1日に約8,000個、2016年までは予約可で今は店頭のみ、80人以上の行列、白味噌と山椒、5個2,250円 (2025年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; cash only; queue on 16 July.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026. Historic family shop: founded 1806, with the 9th–11th generations described in Waraku (intojapanwaraku.com/travel/226066); 11代目 also per co-trip. Drafted under Greg’s ruling on particularly historic family-owned shops, per the coordinator (2026-11-08).

kyoto_beer_bar_lit_karasuma.gf_detail: Not GF: a craft-beer bar (barley and wheat beers), with pasta, fried chicken and bread (reviews).
kyoto_beer_bar_lit_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: food such as fried chicken, cheese omelette and carbonara (reviews).
kyoto_beer_bar_lit_karasuma.hours_raw: Monday and Friday 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–02:00; Tuesday and Thursday 17:30–02:00; weekends and holidays 13:00–02:00; closed Wednesday and every other Tuesday — calendar on Instagram (Tabelog). Table charge ¥330 (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 25 seats with a semi-private room for six; non-smoking (Tabelog). First floor of a building on Karasuma south of Ayanokoji, by Shijo station Exit 6 (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 24 February 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_beer_bar_lit_karasuma.notes: [Craft beer · Karasuma by Shijo station, ten taps] A friendly beer bar a step from Shijo station with ten rotating taps from Japanese craft breweries, helpful explanations and hearty bar food — fried chicken, carbonara — plus an ¥880 pasta lunch on some weekdays. Open till 2 am; ¥330 charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened in February 2023 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a hidden-feeling bar with friendly staff who explain craft beer clearly, beers chosen by a beer sommelier, and a master, Matsu, who chats with solo drinkers.
chef_bio.specialty: Japanese craft beer on ten taps.

anecdotes.text: At a May 2025 company party, one guest drank about five glasses of a yuzu IPA on the free-drink course.
A June 2026 solo drinker stopped in before the last train and chatted with the master, Matsu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアバル＆バー Lit、バル・ビアバー・パスタ、京都市下京区烏丸通綾小路下ル二帖半敷町661 ツカキスクエア1F、月・金 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜翌2:00、火・木 17:30〜翌2:00、土日・祝日 13:00〜翌2:00、水曜定休、隔週火曜休み (インスタグラムで告知)、チャージ330円、カード・QR決済可、電子マネー不可、25席、6名の半個室あり、禁煙、2023年2月24日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 四条駅6番出口のすぐ前、全国から選んだ10タップのクラフトビール、ビアソムリエが選ぶ、マスターのマツさん、わかりやすい説明、クリーミーチーズオムレツ550円、唐揚げ660円、Litのカルボナーラ1,320円、平日のパスタランチ (パンとサラダ付き) 880円、飲み放題のコース、柚子のIPA。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the beers; ¥330 charge.

kyoto_sankichi_horumon_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Horumon and wagyu yakiniku with a house tare, and stews; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_sankichi_horumon_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: offal and wagyu yakiniku (Tabelog).
kyoto_sankichi_horumon_karasuma.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Sunday and holidays; 18:00–23:00 (last food order 22:15, drinks 22:30) Friday, Saturday and holiday eves; closed Tuesday; may close early if ingredients run out; open some days in long holidays — see Instagram (Tabelog). Liver, raw chicken and stews are not always available (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Booking: cancelling after 3 pm on the day costs 100% for course bookings; seat-only no-shows ¥3,000 a head (Tabelog). 27 seats: 7 at the counter, 20 at tables; non-smoking; smokeless grills (Tabelog; December 2024). In a basement (B1F) opposite the Nakagyo post office at Higashinotoin-Sanjo (official site). Opened 8 October 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sankichi_horumon_karasuma.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashinotoin-Sanjo, a revived horumon house] The beloved Sankichi of Urateramachi, brought back by former regulars and staff: fresh horumon and wagyu in the old house sauce, grilled on smokeless roasters in a basement opposite the Nakagyo post office. Friendly crew; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in October 2023 (Tabelog) to revive Sankichi, a horumon restaurant once in Urateramachi; reviewers write that the current chef was a regular and that staff from the old days work here, restoring the original owner’s taste (2024–2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Horumon in the old Sankichi sauce.

anecdotes.text: A January 2024 diner who grew up on the sauce found it restored “100% true to the owner’s taste”.
A December 2024 guest noticed almost no smoke, even from the horumon.
A January 2025 former student regular found the stew close to, but not quite, the original.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 和牛・焼肉・ホルモン三吉 烏丸本店、京都市中京区菱屋町33 珠光ビル三条B1F、東洞院三条の日本郵便中京郵便局の南向かい。食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン、月・水・木・日・祝日 18:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、金土・祝前日 18:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:15、ドリンクL.O.22:30)、火曜定休、食材がなくなり次第早じまい、連休中は営業する日も (インスタグラムで)、レバー・生の鶏・煮込みなどはない日も、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、当日15時以降のキャンセルは100%、席のみ予約の無断キャンセルは1人3,000円、27席 (カウンター7、テーブル20)、禁煙、2023年10月8日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2025年、英語): 裏寺町にあった三吉の復活、元常連の料理人と昔のスタッフ、元の味のたれ、新鮮なホルモン、無煙ロースター、煮込み、和牛が多め、芋焼酎のソーダ割り、気さくなスタッフ、1人6,000〜8,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; some cuts sell out.

kyoto_gion_nakamuraro.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with dashi, miso and soy, dengaku tofu and grilled mochi; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_gion_nakamuraro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki with fish and meat courses (reviews).
kyoto_gion_nakamuraro.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:00–18:30 (last entry at those times); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Book by phone early for banquets and busy seasons (Tabelog). Service charge 10% at lunch and 15% at dinner in the main dining room, 18% in private rooms (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 100 seats with private rooms, some over the garden; non-smoking, with a smoking area (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Just inside Yasaka Shrine’s south gate; about 10 minutes’ walk from Gion-Shijo station Exit 6 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_nakamuraro.notes: [Kaiseki · inside Yasaka Shrine, a Muromachi-era ryotei] A shrine-gate teahouse from the late Muromachi period, long known for dengaku tofu and now a ryotei just inside Yasaka Shrine: seasonal kaiseki in rooms over the garden or facing the shrine’s south gate. Lunch kaiseki about ¥9,700; dinner seatings close early; service 10–18%. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Listed on Hot Pepper as Niken-chaya Nakamuraro: founded in the late Muromachi period as a teahouse at the shrine gate serving its famous dengaku tofu, it became a ryotei (料理茶屋) at the end of the Edo period, and cites 480 years of hospitality (Hot Pepper; Tabelog). A February 2026 reviewer traced it back to the days of the Niken-chaya teahouses.
chef_bio.philosophy: A casual visit to a traditional ryotei (July 2026 review, quoting the restaurant’s concept).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 Gion Festival lunch ended with matcha and charcoal-grilled Chigo-mochi.
A February 2026 diner took a second-floor room looking onto Yasaka Shrine’s south gate.
A July 2026 family of three had the ¥9,680 lunch kaiseki in a garden-view room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ホットペッパー: 二軒茶屋 中村楼、京都市東山区祇園町南側509、創業 室町期、室町末期に門前茶屋として創業し名物の田楽豆腐などを供すようになり江戸末期から料理茶屋に、四八〇年来のおもてなしの心。食べログ: 中村楼、日本料理、八坂神社の南楼門をくぐってすぐ、480年の文化、季節の会席9,680円と6,655円 (税込、前日までの予約)、昼11:30〜14:00、夜17:00〜18:30 (いずれも最終入店)、水曜定休、宴会などで混むため早めに電話で予約を、サービス料は個室18%、個室以外は昼10%・夜15%、カード (銀聯も)・電子マネー・QR決済可、100席、個室あり、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昼の会席9,680円、庭を望む「鶴亀松」の間、2階から南楼門、二軒茶屋の時代から、祇園祭の抹茶と稚児餅、フレンチ風のコース、季節の京懐石、団体利用でビールがぬるかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; service 10–18%.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026. History (late Muromachi founding, 480 years) from Hot Pepper (hotpepper.jp/strJ000108545) and Tabelog; the official site is script-rendered and could not be read.

kyoto_sokoku_breakfast.gf_detail: Ask. A Japanese breakfast of rice, miso soup, grilled fish, tofu and vegetables (2024–26 reviews); soy and dashi are likely.
kyoto_sokoku_breakfast.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled fish or salmon yukke, dashimaki, bonito flakes (November 2024 review).
kyoto_sokoku_breakfast.hours_raw: Tue 8:30–10:30; Sat and Sun 8:30–11:30; closed Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri; hours may change (Tabelog). A February 2026 review calls it weekends-and-holidays breakfast; busy, about a 30-minute wait without a booking — book ahead (February 2026 review). QR payments; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A traditional house with a garden view, 10 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog; November 2024 review).
kyoto_sokoku_breakfast.notes: [Japanese breakfast · Higashiyama] A weekend breakfast house with a garden view, 10 minutes from Kiyomizu-Gojo: a gentle, elegant ¥1,500 set of the day's fish, dashimaki, tofu, miso soup and rice. Popular — book ahead.

chef_bio.background: A breakfast specialist in a traditional house with a garden view (November 2024 and February 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 couple on a morning stroll near family home found it newly opened and chose salmon yukke and grilled mackerel.
A February 2026 visitor arriving at opening on a long weekend waited about 30 minutes without a booking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 蘇谷、カフェ・日本料理、東山区鐘鋳町392、清水五条駅から徒歩10分、火曜 8:30〜10:30、土曜・日曜 8:30〜11:30、月・水・木・金曜休み、QR 可、カード・電子マネー不可、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 週末の朝ごはんの店、庭の見える和の家、一汁三菜1,500円、サーモンのユッケか焼き鯖、だし巻き、豆腐、おひたし、山椒のかつお節、味噌汁、ご飯、予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead at weekends (February 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_beer_pub_takumiya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a craft-beer pub (barley beer); food includes dim sum and sausages (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_beer_pub_takumiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: homemade sausages, oysters, tripe (2025–26 reviews); grilled edamame is an exception to ask about.
kyoto_beer_pub_takumiya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 25 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Oshikoji west of Higashinotoin, 5 min from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_beer_pub_takumiya.notes: [Craft beer · Karasuma-Oike] The brewery-run pub of KYOTO NUDE BREWERY near Karasuma-Oike, with about nine taps, homemade sausages, rock oysters and even dim sum; staff explain each beer. About ¥2,000–7,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 March 2015 (Tabelog); the directly run outlet of KYOTO NUDE BREWERY (March 2026 review). A young, knowledgeable manager (August 2025 review). Canned beer is sold at another shop on the main street (November 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor from Chiba on a third trip tried every fresh-hop beer and found the IPA gentle in bitterness.
A June 2026 drinker started at 4 pm with fresh rock oysters and the NUDE IPA.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BEER PUB TAKUMIYA、居酒屋・日本料理・魚介料理、中京区、押小路東洞院の西、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 16:00〜23:00、土日・祝日 15:00〜23:00、不定休、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、25席、禁煙、2015年3月10日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): KYOTO NUDE BREWERY の直営、約9タップ、No.1 NUDE BEER (M) 1,100円、焼き枝豆600円、自家製ソーセージ、岩牡蠣、ハチノスのトマト煮、点心、前菜の盛り合わせ。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain each beer (July 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_kyo_gateau_the_marie.gf_detail: Reviews say all the cakes are gluten-free, made without wheat, using rice flour (August and September 2025; December 2025); confirm cross-contact with the shop.
kyoto_kyo_gateau_the_marie.vegan_detail: Ask. The cakes use soy-milk cream butter (December 2025 review; September 2023 review), but eggs are not ruled out.
kyoto_kyo_gateau_the_marie.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 12:00–21:00; closed Wednesdays; hours may change (Tabelog). Mainly take-out, with eat-in since July 2023 (July and September 2023 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Down an alley through the gate of 京薬膳なつめ, at the same address (August 2025 review; Tabelog). 10 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (November 2023 review).
kyoto_kyo_gateau_the_marie.notes: [Gluten-free cakes · Fuyacho-Nijo] A hidden alley cake shop of temari-ball cream puffs and chiffons, all made with rice flour and soy-milk cream butter — reviewers report every cake is gluten-free. Mostly take-out; under ¥1,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 8 April 2023 (Tabelog); desserts inspired by temari balls, from gentle ingredients such as rice flour and soy-milk cream butter (September 2023 review); shown on Kansai TV (November 2023 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Temari cream puffs; rice-flour roll cakes.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 parent whose child avoids animal-based cream watched the child happily finish a cream puff and try the cake too.
A September 2025 visitor, delighted that every cake was wheat-free, bought a fruit chiffon and a Shine Muscat roll.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京gateau the marie、スイーツ・ケーキ、中京区布袋屋町520-3、月・火・木〜日 12:00〜21:00、水曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2023年4月8日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2025年、英語): 京薬膳なつめの門をくぐった路地の奥、手まりのシュークリーム、米粉と豆乳クリームバターのケーキ、全部グルテンフリー (2025年8月・9月)、フルーツのシフォン620円、シャインマスカットのロール760円、持ち帰り中心、2023年7月からイートインも。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden at the end of an alley (2023–25 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through December 2025.

kyoto_yomogi_sokyudo_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Mochi and daifuku with bean paste (2025–26 reviews); a daily bento with nikujaga (June 2026).
kyoto_yomogi_sokyudo_nijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Mochi and bean-paste sweets may suit; the bento includes meat and egg (June 2026 review).
kyoto_yomogi_sokyudo_nijo.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 10:00–17:00; closed Wednesdays; hours may change (Tabelog). No cards or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats at tables, plus two outside in summer; non-smoking (Tabelog). Take-out wagashi and eat-in with drinks (February 2026 review). About 500 m from Sanjo Keihan (Tabelog).
kyoto_yomogi_sokyudo_nijo.notes: [Wagashi café · Sakyo] A small wagashi shop with a twelve-seat café: strawberry daifuku and kusa mochi to take away or eat in with tea, chilled ame in summer and a homestyle daily bento. Under ¥1,500; cash only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 24 September 2014 (Tabelog) as the Nijo shop of 双鳩堂.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular comes as much for the daily bento as for the sweets — nikujaga that day, with eggs and salads.
A January 2025 museum-goer from Okazaki Park picked up sakura mochi and strawberry daifuku to eat at the hotel.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: よもぎ 双鳩堂二条店、和菓子・甘味処・カフェ、左京区吉永町271-1、三条京阪駅から505m、月・火・木〜日 10:00〜17:00、水曜休み、カード・QR 不可、12席、禁煙、2014年9月24日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): いちご大福、草餅、桜餅 (240〜320円ほど)、そば茶450円、冷やしあめ、日替わりの弁当 (肉じゃがなど)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_sobadokoro_miyako_nishinotoin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba (with wheat flour, usually) and udon; tempura (2026 reviews) — ask about 100% buckwheat.
kyoto_sobadokoro_miyako_nishinotoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broth, tamago-don, tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sobadokoro_miyako_nishinotoin.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Queues at lunch; can sell out after 2 pm (May 2026 review). PayPay; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 22 seats at tables; no smoking 11:00–14:00 (Tabelog). On Nishinotoin south of Takoyakushi, 5 min from Shijo or Karasuma (Tabelog).
kyoto_sobadokoro_miyako_nishinotoin.notes: [Soba · Nishinotoin] A tidy, family-run soba shop near Shijo-Karasuma with lunchtime queues: elegant pale soba with a seasonal sesame dipping sauce, a soft tamago-don and a delicate dashi. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.background: A family-run soba shop (July 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner, defeated by queues and sold-out signs for two years, finally got in at 11:50 for the daily special.
An April 2026 regular found the small tamago-don just like the one from the now-closed Owariya.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば処 みやこ、そば・うどん、中京区西洞院通蛸薬師下る古西町429、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分すぎ、月〜金 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜21:00、土 11:30〜15:00、日曜・祝日休み、PayPay 可、カード・電子マネー不可、22席、11〜14時は禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): 家族経営、季節のごまだれのつけそば1,100円、殻をむいた白いそば、ざるそば、玉吸い、小さな玉子丼、日替わり、昼は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue at lunch; PayPay or cash.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.
